title: Binance Futures Mock Trading and Futures Testnet Upgrade and Revamp
text: This is a general announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. Fellow Binancians, Binance Futures Mock Trading and Futures testnet services  will undergo upgrade and revamp to better serve users.  Updates:  Futures Mock Trading on Binance App:  To support the upgrade, Futures Mock Trading will be made unavailable on certain versions of the Binance App until further notice. Futures Testnet on Binance Website : To support the upgrade, access to Futures testnet will also be gradually made unavailable.  We look forward to bringing back these features and introducing new enhancements soon. Please stay tuned for future announcements.  Note : There may be discrepancies between this original content in English and any translated versions. Please refer to the original English version for the most accurate information, in case any discrepancies arise. Thank you for your support! Binance Team 2025-08-27
